description: This source file implements platform-dependent and utility functions for the Slap Loam Server Object within the Service Logic Aggregation Plane (SLAP). It primarily defines a function to create and return a new Loam Server object handle.

methods.name: ANSC_HANDLE SlapCreateLoamServer(ANSC_HANDLE hContainerContext,ANSC_HANDLE hOwnerContext,ANSC_HANDLE hAnscReserved)
